description: Produces sound-effect files (up to 16 per call) to embed in an app, game, UI or video. Each item is one of: a role (press, release, toggle_on, toggle_off, continuous_tick, success, warning, notify, complete) with a shared family (seed, character, root, scale) for a coherent UI set with playback hints; a recipe (describe topic=recipes; recipes are starting points) tailored with pitch, bright, dur and seed, pairs alike; or an instrument line with play, which auditions one designed voice. Kinds mix in one call. revise patches a family by its handle. Reports design_mode and loudness; WAV by default, Ogg or Opus on request. Files last 2 h; https://moosetracker.app/acceptable-use.html Schema 2d544474.

format.description: Default wav; ogg = Vorbis 44.1 kHz; opus = Ogg Opus 48 kHz

dur.description: Length in seconds, fitted within 8% or 30 ms

instrument.description: Audition one voice: text after iN, e.g. - wave=saw cutoff=45 or sample "upright-bass" (describe topic=instrument)

mtl.description: Custom effect as a tiny MTL song (<= 2048 bytes)

play.description: Notes for instrument: C3 E3, chord C3+E3, C3:4 = 4 beats, . = rest

seed.description: 0 = plain recipe; others shift pitch, length and tone repeatably (reproducible, not unique)

pitch.description: Semitones; 12 = octave. Lower is heavier, higher lighter

name: sfx
title: Make sound effects
